description: Computed field ('Is this a computed field?' toggle + Formula builder): the FOURTH Expression owner — Field. Captured live 2026-08-12 (#48, browser round) by building concatenate("BR-", <Number field>) in the real builder and reading the draft back. Same Node AST family as branch/goto/property Expressions.
notes: This REPLACES the 'Kissflow has no formula or computed field type' belief: the field Settings tab has an 'Is this a computed field?' toggle opening a full Formula builder. Field events remain a separate, still-valid mechanism for script-based computation.

Formula function catalog seen in the builder: rand, randBetween, dateDiff, calendarDays, currency, number, if, concatenate, date, dateTime, dateFromText, dateTimeFromText, now, initiatedat, today, isBlank, false, true, not.
ExpressionStr references fields BY FIELD ID (concatenate("BR-", Field_09d27548d1) on the wire) — same readable-mirror-only rule as every other Expression; the Node AST is what matters.
The root Function node here has NO Syntax key (prefix call) — unlike the Infix '=' comparison roots; DataType/Category derive from the function's own result/operands.

The computed toggle DISABLES DefaultValue (mutually exclusive in the UI). The one-time '=IF(...) in DefaultValue' sighting was probably this feature read back wrong, or a legacy serialization — the current builder writes Field::Expression, not a DefaultValue formula.

RUNTIME: the formula did NOT evaluate on an admin data-plane fill (value stayed null on fresh and existing items) — evaluation appears to be client-side in the form UI or at submit; API-driven runtime proof still open (submit was blocked by the user-not-in-role 403).
Builder marks computed fields with a green fx badge; Save in the formula modal stays disabled until every field ref resolves (insert refs via the picker, typed names do not resolve).
